claims.claim: Toyota Camry Japan Gear box 22pin 2008/010/12 very strong and affordable
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an engine block/engine assembly with a blue circular cover/plate removed/exposed and gasket/bolt-hole areas; no gearbox/22-pin connector, Camry identification, or 2008/010/12 markings are shown.

risks.risk: Item mismatch: witness report appears to be an engine assembly, while seller claims a Camry gearbox (22-pin). If it’s the wrong part, resale value drops sharply.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the gearbox casing with model/part number label and the 22-pin connector/plug (including pin count visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine assembly (or as not-confirmed gearbox) at the worst-case for buyer risk: treat as parts-only/untested.

risks.risk: Unknown make/model/part number: without readable identifiers, compatibility is uncertain for a Lagos buyer.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any ID plate/label/engraving/part number on the unit (and a wider shot showing the full unit).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified/unknown compatibility used unit (untested).

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty (internal damage): witness notes used staining and exposed gasket surfaces, but cracks/warping/scoring/corrosion depth are not shown.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of gasket surfaces and any suspected damage areas (including straight-edge/flatness check if possible) plus photos of all sides.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/needs overhaul (worst-case: assume seals/gaskets may be compromised).

risks.risk: Missing components: witness explicitly says it’s unclear whether the blue cover/plate is included or already removed, and whether all related parts/gaskets/bolts are present.
risks.proof: Photo inventory showing included items: the blue cover/plate (if separate), all gaskets, bolts, and any loose parts laid out and counted.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/parts-only until all missing components are confirmed.

risks.risk: No functional verification: no evidence of whether it was working before removal; no leak test/compression test results shown.
risks.proof: Video/clip of the unit running (if applicable) or documented test results (leak test/compression test) with timestamps.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested (worst-case: assume it may not be functional).

proof_requests: Send clear photos that identify the gearbox (not engine): gearbox casing label/part number and the 22-pin connector with pin count visible.
Confirm whether the blue circular plate/cover is included or already removed; show it as a separate included item if applicable.
Provide close-ups of gasket surfaces and any damage (cracks/warping/scoring/corrosion) from multiple angles.
Show a full set of included parts: gaskets, bolts, and any related components laid out and counted.
Provide proof of working condition: video of operation or any leak/compression test results (with readable readings).
response.reason: The witness photos do not confirm the seller’s claimed gearbox (22-pin Camry) and key identifiers/condition details are missing. Without a matching, readable part identity and completeness/working proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
